name: home-assistant
description: Home Assistant integration — read entity states and history, list services, and call services to control devices via the Home Assistant REST API, authenticated with a Long-Lived Access Token.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Home Assistant entity states, history, and service calls

fields.label: Base URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance (the /api path is appended automatically).

tools.name: ha.list_states
tools.description: List all entities with their current state and friendly name.

tools.name: ha.get_state
tools.description: Get the full state object for a single entity.

tools.name: ha.list_services
tools.description: List the available service domains and the services each exposes.

tools.name: ha.call_service
tools.description: Call a Home Assistant service to control a device or entity (e.g. turn on a light, unlock a door). Can perform real-world actions and is not always reversible.

domain.description: Service domain, e.g. light, switch, lock

service.description: Service name within the domain, e.g. turn_on, unlock

entityId.description: Optional target entity id, e.g. light.living_room

data.description: Optional extra service data merged into the request body, e.g. {"brightness": 128}

tools.name: ha.get_history
tools.description: Get recent state history for an entity over the past N hours.

hours.description: How many hours of history to fetch (default 24)
